grabber.title: IMAGE COLLECTION
grabber.stop.hint: Stop requested. Waiting for the current request and cleanup; this is not an immediate stop.
grabber.service.hint: ArtistSourceGrabber is installed but not running. Start its local service first.
grabber.service.lifecycle: Closing the UI process leaves the collection service and its task running. Restarting the UI cannot take over that service or task. Refreshing this page is different from restarting the UI process.
grabber.install.hint: ArtistSourceGrabber is unavailable. Install it alongside this workbench; no files will be downloaded until the service is ready.
grabber.download.hint: Actual service download root. The output folder is a sanitized child name, not an arbitrary path.
grabber.search.choose: Choose a candidate or enter the source identifier directly.
grabber.search.empty: No candidates returned. You can still enter a source identifier directly.
grabber.artist.hint: Enter an artist tag, ID or profile URL supported by this source. Search is optional.
grabber.character.hint: Danbooru character mode uses tag search; results are not guaranteed to be character-category only.
grabber.count.hint: Target per source, not a combined total. Suggested: 200. Unlimited still obeys source/page limits; existing files count as completed.
grabber.secret.hint: Passwords are never shown. Empty values keep stored secrets; tick Clear saved value and Save to remove explicitly. Credentials are stored locally by the backend.
grabber.saved: Settings saved. Secret values remain hidden.
grabber.session.title: BROWSER LOGIN
grabber.session.pending: Not logged in yet; complete login in the dedicated window, then check again.
grabber.remote.title: IMAGE TRANSFER CONSENT
grabber.remote.hint: I allow collected images to be sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint for tagging. Network use and provider charges may apply.
grabber.remote.required: Confirm image transfer before starting with a remote tagger.
grabber.ephemeral: Current service task only; no reliable saved history.
grabber.empty.results: No live results in this filter yet. Browse previously downloaded files in Downloaded data.
grabber.config.hint: Read-only, redacted. After a page refresh only the fields exposed by the current task snapshot are available.
grabber.previewFailed: Preview unavailable. Open the detail view to view the original image, or refresh to retry.
grabber.connection: Connection interrupted. Data retained; automatic read-only recovery continues. {error}
grabber.request.failed: The service did not confirm success.
grabber.alreadyRunning: A task is already running. Wait for its terminal state before creating another.
grabber.validation.artist: Enter an artist or source query first.
grabber.validation.count: Count must be a positive integer, or explicitly select Unlimited.
grabber.validation.pages: Pages must be integers: start 1–1000, end 0–1000; nonzero end must not precede start.
grabber.folder.hint: Leave empty to name the folder after the query object. In artist mode, this name also becomes an artist tag when Include artist tag is enabled.
grabber.field.images_only: Download images only, without saving tags
grabber.imagesOnly.hint: No tagging or new .txt files. Existing .txt files are not deleted. Tag settings are retained for when this option is turned off.
grabber.imagesOnly.unsupported: This service does not advertise images-only support. Update and restart the collection service to enable it.
grabber.config.unknown: The task configuration cannot be fully recovered. Only this read-only service snapshot is known; missing settings are unknown, not defaults.
grabber.config.draft: Editable fields are the next task draft; results and This config belong to the last task.
grabber.config.empty: No task has been started. This config will show the submitted, redacted task configuration, not the editable draft.
grabber.search.unsupported: No candidates for this query mode on this source. Enter the query directly to start; no other site is searched.
grabber.query.artist.label: Artist / source identifier
grabber.query.artist.placeholder: Artist tag, ID or profile URL
grabber.query.artist.hint: Enter an artist identifier supported by this source. Candidate search is optional.
grabber.query.character.label: Character tags
grabber.query.character.placeholder: Character tag used by this source
grabber.query.character.hint: Use this source’s character tags; spaces separate multiple query tags.
grabber.query.tag.label: Tag query
grabber.query.tag.hint: Enter tags understood by this source, separated by spaces.
grabber.query.keyword.label: Search keywords
grabber.query.keyword.hint: Openverse uses a keyword search, not a strict AND tag intersection.
grabber.results.live: Live results of the current service task, updated during collection — not the historical disk library.
grabber.multi.hint: Select at least one source. Each uses its own query, rating and credentials; all write to the shared output folder.
grabber.multi.unsupported: This service does not advertise multi-source support. Update and restart it before selecting multiple sources.
grabber.multi.editHint: This selector edits one site, not the collection selection. Candidates apply only to this site; X/Pixiv identities are never guessed.
grabber.multi.required: Select at least one collection source.
grabber.multi.queryUnsupported: The query mode is not supported by this source. Select an available mode.
grabber.models.hint: Optional directory; empty uses the configured default. Scanning only lists local files — it does not load or download models. Manual paths below remain available.
grabber.models.gpu: Default: prefer available GPU providers, with CPU fallback.
grabber.models.compatibility: Compatible with WD14 / WD Tagger-style ONNX; pair the model with selected_tags.csv from the same version. For other models, confirm input preprocessing and output label order.
grabber.models.inputOutput: Input: float32 BGR, 0–255; center on a white square, then resize; NHWC / NCHW layout inferred from the input shape. The first output is flattened and matched to CSV rows in order (blank names are skipped).
grabber.models.csvCategories: CSV requires name; category is optional (general 0, character 4). Without category, the default 0,4 filter yields no tags; clear the category filter in advanced settings to include all categories.
grabber.models.validationScope: Cannot directly load .pth / .safetensors or arbitrary CLIP / LLM models. Validate tagger checks model and CSV loading only, not inference compatibility or tag quality.
grabber.library.retry: Refresh to retry. If image navigation failed, you can also click navigation again.
grabber.models.truncated: Scan was limited. Use a narrower directory if the model is missing.
grabber.models.found: Choose a model to fill its model and matching CSV paths.
grabber.models.empty: No ONNX models found. You can enter paths manually.
grabber.models.noCsv: No matching CSV. The previous CSV path was cleared; enter the correct tags CSV manually.
grabber.library.unsupported: This service does not advertise disk-library support. Update and restart the collection service.
grabber.library.retagUnsupported: This service does not advertise re-tagging support. Update and restart the collection service.
grabber.library.hint: Browse real groups under the download directory, independent of the current task. Select a thumbnail to inspect saved tags.
grabber.library.truncated: The listing is truncated. Some entries may not be shown.
grabber.library.backupHint: An explicit action, separate from collection. Existing captions are backed up before being changed. Collection and re-tagging cannot run together.
grabber.library.modelRequired: Choose a local ONNX or remote tagger in the settings below first.
grabber.library.independent: These are the shared model settings. You can configure and explicitly run re-tagging even with “images only” enabled; collection options are not changed.
grabber.library.confirm_replace: I confirm replacing existing captions in this group; originals will be backed up.
grabber.library.confirm_remote: I allow images in this group to be sent to the configured remote endpoint. Network traffic and provider charges may apply.
grabber.library.replaceRequired: Explicitly confirm replacing captions before starting.
grabber.library.progressUnknown: Re-tag status is unknown. Wait for the status connection to recover before starting a task.
grabber.annotation.delete: Delete annotation file (the image is kept)
grabber.annotation.rawHint: Only mapped string/string-array values may change; keys, structure and other bytes are protected by the server.
grabber.annotation.writeWarning: Do not save with external editors during apply. Per-file writes can partially succeed; stop does not undo completed writes.
grabber.annotation.saveBeforeLeave: Save previews the source diff and waits for your Apply confirmation. Any conflict keeps you here.
grabber.annotation.incomplete: Incomplete snapshot: mutations and translation are disabled.
grabber.annotation.groupsTruncated: Group list is truncated; only explicitly listed groups are available.
grabber.annotation.selectRequired: Select at least one image on the current page.
grabber.annotation.confirmRequired: Confirm a binding and select a mapped field first.
grabber.annotation.sharedDelete: Shared files cannot be deleted here. Clear selected fields instead.
grabber.annotation.conflict: Partial, stopped or conflicting job. Draft retained; review rows and explicitly reload/re-preview.
grabber.annotation.mappingHint: Fields are a JSON array of {pointer,type}. Record IDs are opaque server IDs, one per line; blank confirms all mapped records for this image.
grabber.annotation.retagWarning: Retag always targets the entire group, never the checkbox selection. Confirm annotation types first; the service rejects protected NL/shared files.
grabber.annotation.retagProtected: Known protected annotations in this group: retag is disabled.
grabber.translation.title: Translation
grabber.translation.linked: Outlined and underlined segments correspond by saved server ID, not by matching words.
grabber.translation.switchLanguagePair: Explicitly permit changing the saved language pair
grabber.translation.costHint: API requests may incur charges. Prices are unknown. Cancellation cannot refund sent calls; a new retry plan may charge again. Missing/failed entries keep the source.
grabber.translation.confirmCost: I explicitly authorize remote calls and this exact token maximum / possible charges.
grabber.translation.license: Dictionary origin/license metadata are declarations, not independently verified. No automatic downloads.
grabber.translation.identityMismatch: Translation identity does not match the saved source or language snapshot. Reload before linking or saving.
grabber.translation.linkDisabled: Linking disabled: unsaved source, missing/failed translation, or mismatched source/language snapshot.
grabber.annotation.option.caption: Caption
grabber.annotation.create:value: Initial content (array tags: one per line)
grabber.annotation.draftMappingChanged: Record/field identity changed. The original draft is retained but cannot be remapped safely; discard it explicitly before editing the new mapping.
grabber.translation.orphanDraft: Source identity changed; retained old manual draft (not aligned or saved):
grabber.annotation.pageScopeHint: Selected-page actions use only checked IDs on the displayed page; off-page checks are remembered, not submitted. A new snapshot clears checks.
grabber.annotation.segmentPageHint: Both columns show the current field in pages of at most 60 segments. Translate previews only this displayed segment page; off-page drafts and missing selections are retained.
gbc.title: GBC workspace
gbc.graph.mediaLoading: Loading authenticated image preview… Previous image cleared.
gbc.graph.decodeFailed: Image decoding failed. No previous image is retained; select the sample again to retry.
gbc.scope: Local graph generation, validated datasets and immutable training drafts. Nothing starts automatically.
gbc.working: Working… Do not repeat this action.
gbc.ready: State updated. Saving is not running or validating.
gbc.capabilityNote: Contract support does not mean installed dependencies, GPU fit or verified inference. Run an explicit version/doctor probe and task check.
gbc.remoteDisabled: Remote APIs are disabled. No image egress and no model credentials are collected. Future remote support would require explicit egress confirmation.
gbc.tab.caption: Caption & draft
gbc.environment.title: Trusted paths and runtimes
gbc.environment.trust: Register existing local directories and Python interpreters only. Registration grants authority but does not execute, install or download anything.
gbc.environment.confirmRoot: I trust this directory for the selected purpose
gbc.environment.confirmRuntime: I trust this executable for later explicit execution
gbc.environment.probeNote: Version/doctor run trusted code. Data-runtime validation is performed by an explicit import/validate operation, not this generator probe.
gbc.environment.confirmProbe: Execute the selected trusted generator runtime to probe its environment?
gbc.tasks.title: Prepare, check, then run
gbc.tasks.limits: Replay consumes an existing trace, not new-image inference. Local v1 uses a fixed engine profile; no arbitrary Python, engine imports, CLI arguments or remote model IDs.
gbc.tasks.path: Relative image folder / JSONL / trace path
gbc.tasks.empty: No task selected. Create a task or select a saved one.
gbc.tasks.confirmRun: Start this checked GBC generation task? It may consume GPU memory and compute. This does not start training.
gbc.model.note: Existing local safetensors only. Official profile targets at least 24 GiB; not an 8 GiB guarantee. No automatic downloads. Real inference has not been verified.
gbc.jobs.confirmForce: Force stop the selected owned job? Partial output may remain; it is not a validated dataset.
gbc.jobs.empty: No job selected. Checks and probes also appear here.
gbc.jobs.noPercent: Observed files are not semantic validation. Exit zero may still be partial; no invented completion percentage.
gbc.jobs.logMeta: Byte cursor {cursor} · dropped bytes {dropped} · display keeps the latest 128 KiB
gbc.datasets.title: Validated GBC datasets
gbc.datasets.exportNote: Export explicitly packs an artifact into a new standard dataset, then validates it. No source overwrite or repair; partial failures are retained.
gbc.datasets.empty: No registered dataset selected. Import a standard package or export a task artifact.
gbc.datasets.countNote: Declared, manifest and validated counts are distinct. A dash is unknown, never zero. Paging is not full validation.
gbc.datasets.confirmImport: Copy this existing standard package into a new output directory and run full validation with the selected data runtime?
gbc.datasets.confirmExport: Pack this artifact into a new output directory and validate the standard dataset?
gbc.datasets.confirmValidate: Re-read and hash the whole registered dataset using the selected data runtime? Changed content requires a new import.
gbc.samples.title: Graph inspection
gbc.samples.empty: Read a dataset or artifact page explicitly to inspect its graph.
gbc.graph.title: Image and graph
gbc.graph.empty: Choose a sample to link its boxes, nodes and edge descriptions.
gbc.graph.keys: Node focus: arrow keys, Home and End
gbc.graph.mediaUnavailable: Image endpoint unavailable. Boxes use validated displayBbox; original bbox is unchanged.
gbc.graph.original: Stored-image coordinates. Display clipping does not modify source boxes.
gbc.draft.title: Caption template and typed draft
gbc.draft.note: Select a validated dataset and shards, then choose a trusted base config. Every save creates a new immutable ID. Never queue, add to notebook or train automatically.
gbc.draft.useJson: Use this full JSON instead of the controls
gbc.draft.jsonNote: JSON stays editable after validation errors. Metadata rules and Python regexes are checked by the server. Weighted tag sources choose one, not concatenate all.
gbc.draft.knobPatch: Typed knob patch (JSON object, no truncation)
gbc.draft.fixGeometry: Set center crop, no flip, selected mode
gbc.draft.geometryNote: GBC geometry requires CROP=center, FLIP=false and a non-shifted_square mode. Inherited conflicts are rejected, never silently corrected. No example multi-GPU settings are copied.
gbc.draft.geometryFixed: Explicit geometry correction applied to the patch. Create a new draft to use it.
gbc.draft.confirmConfig: I trust this base config and allow loading it in the trainer subprocess (not training)
gbc.draft.budgetNote: Actual planner geometry and character estimate are authoritative. hardTokenLimit=false: not a strict token limit. Preview RNG uses row=0; it is not an unknown training catalog row.
gbc.draft.chooseBase: Choose a base configuration explicitly; no multi-GPU example is selected for you.
gbc.draft.required: Choose a dataset, at least one shard and a base config, then confirm trusted config loading.
gbc.draft.sampleRequired: Choose a sample in this draft's selected shards.
gbc.draft.open: Review typed draft in New training
gbc.draft.created: Created {id}. No check or training started.
gbc.draft.previewReady: Caption preview returned from the real trainer adapter.
gbc.draft.edited: Unsaved edits: create a new draft ID before previewing this configuration.
gbc.draft.readonly: This route preserves the exact draftId, revision and effectiveHash. Values are read only and bypass legacy overrides. No training, queue or notebook action is available here.
gbc.draft.confirmCheck: Run the trainer configuration checker for this exact immutable draft? It does not train.
gbc.draft.checkPassed: Exact draft check passed. No training started.
gbc.draft.checkFailed: Draft validation failed. Inspect the output below; HTTP success is not check success.
gbc.draft.readyCheck: Exact reference verified. Explicit check is available; nothing starts automatically.
gbc.error.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Mutation outcome unknown. Do not resubmit blindly; refresh resources and reconcile requestId.
gbc.error.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot read the service. Refresh to retry the read.
gbc.error.VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE: Incompatible GBC API version. Update the UI and service together.
gbc.error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Authentication required. Open the UI with its valid session token.
gbc.error.PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission denied. Check registered path permissions.
gbc.error.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Runtime dependencies are not installed. Nothing was installed automatically.
gbc.error.VALIDATION_FAILED: Validation failed. Correct the configuration or dataset and check again.
gbc.error.VERSION_CONFLICT: Revision or hash conflict. Reload the exact resource; create a new draft for edits.
gbc.error.SOURCE_CHANGED: Source changed. Import a new dataset or create a fresh task/draft.
gbc.error.BUSY: A managed job or training lease is busy. Wait or explicitly stop its owner.
gbc.error.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Manual recovery required; no automatic resume or process kill.
gbc.error.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This capability is unavailable in the current service.
gbc.error.NOT_FOUND: Resource not found. Refresh the selection.
gbc.error.INVALID_REQUEST: Invalid input. Check the named field; your input is preserved.
gbc.error.OTHER: Operation failed; inspect the diagnostic code.
